periods.semantics: Half-open raw broker-labelled intervals, no UTC/external-session transform. Raw labels define ordering/date/timeout coordinates, not a solved external clock. Calendar-known entry cutoff never uses future row counts.

signal.observations: Completed M1 Bid closes update state; high/low/previous close enter prior true range only. No spread, volume, hour, weekday, cross-symbol return, external source, or old signal determines direction.
signal.scale: At initialization and each confirmation, freeze delta = 8 times arithmetic mean true range of the 60 completed M1 bars strictly before the confirming bar. Current-bar range is excluded. Delta stays constant throughout the new leg.
signal.scale_rationale: A prospective excursion scale several times a one-minute range aims to represent cumulative movement rather than single-bar flicker. Eight and sixty are not empirically optimized. An informal unexecuted 3x sketch preceded this binding 8x choice; no feature, supply or return was calculated for either.
signal.gap_rule: When current timestamp differs from previous+60, clear signal state and true-range window before consuming that bar; its first range is high-low. Require 60 strictly prior consecutive bars before initialization. Owned positions retain stop/timeout protection. Reset never retroactively deletes an emitted event.
signal.initialization: At the first ready completed bar, store close as neutral anchor and freeze delta. Wait for close to reach anchor plus/minus delta. That initial direction starts a leg at its confirmation close and new prior-range delta but emits no tradable event because no completed overshoot exists.
signal.active_leg: Track most favorable completed close since direction confirmation. Up leg confirms down when close <= running_high - frozen_delta; down leg confirms up when close >= running_low + frozen_delta. At most one change per bar. Completed overshoot = max(0, old_direction*(old_extreme-old_confirmation_close)); record its ratio to old delta. Emit new direction and old trigger delta, then start new leg at current close with current strictly-prior scale.
signal.decision_and_freshness: Bar labelled t closes at t+60; its entry intent is usable only at exact t+60. Missing entry quote expires admission but preserves the event. No future path/completeness enters event creation. Native EA must additionally reject stale/duplicate packets.

variants.DC_OVERSHOOT_CONTEXT: When completed overshoot >= old trigger delta, trade opposite new direction; otherwise follow new direction. Equality is in the long-overshoot branch. No threshold search.

geometry.exit: On the next confirmed event for its symbol, fully close any owned position; after complete close the new event may start a lifecycle at the same opening batch. Otherwise exit at first available quote at/after 240 raw minutes. Protective stop stays active. No take, trail, partial close, stop refill or entry without a fresh event. Stop distance uses twice old trigger delta, rounded outward to broker tick size.

risk.lot_rounding: Floor target volume to step; minimum volume only within 3% hard stop-risk cap; respect max volume. Reserve full original stop risk until complete close. Stop risk is measured from actual execution price to liquidation-side stop.
risk.batch: After all same-time opening gap/scheduled/event exits, freeze one reference min(actual cash, opening liquidation equity). Same-time admissions all use that positive reference in US100, US30, US500 order. Process every current M1 high/low only after the whole opening batch. Stress does not select another size/path.
risk.margin_limit: No exact historical margin rates in snapshots; optimistic risk-limited screen with no invented CFD margin formula. Native margin admission is mandatory for a survivor.

costs_and_proxy.bid_ask: Bid OHLC plus row spread times point. Long entry Ask/exit Bid, short entry Bid/exit Ask. USD directional difference times contract size and lots. Row spread is representative, not a certified first-tick or intrabar Ask series.
costs_and_proxy.within_bar: Opening gap through stop fills at adverse liquidation-side open before scheduled/event exits. Intrabar stop uses low Bid for long, high Bid plus row spread for short; fill fixed stop. A same-bar stop cannot create another entry without a fresh event.
costs_and_proxy.spread_stress: Subtract one further observed direction-specific burden on actual-sized trades: long entry spread or short exit spread. Separately subtract half-entry plus half-exit spread. Both stresses must pass.
costs_and_proxy.commission_limit: Zero is optimistic snapshot-limited screening, not historical/native certification.
costs_and_proxy.swap: Use numeric snapshot mode 2 as USD per lot, charged at each crossed broker-date midnight after a held weekday, triple on the declared weekday ending there; no extra weekend charge. Charge before opening exits, never for a position first opened at that boundary. Historical rates/raw-clock certainty remain proxy limits.
costs_and_proxy.financing_robustness: A third stress subtracts all positive swap credits from the directionally stressed same-trade result; negative charges remain. It must also pass profit and each-year gates. No alternative sizing path.
costs_and_proxy.drawdown: Global liquidation-side M1 opening and closing marked equity. Native intrabar DD can be higher; call this proxy marked DD.
costs_and_proxy.integrity: Preserve events, admissions, full closes, financing and marked equity. Normal result production reconciles all accepted starts to one full close, final flat state, cash/P&L/epochs and each spread/financing stress. Incomplete data/accounting is correction, not adverse. No checker CLI, tests or CI.

structural_stage.meaning: Generate causal events only. No forward returns, stop path, profit, sizing or accepted-fill calculations. All roles share the same optimistic supply.
structural_stage.normal_dates: Every distinct development date in three-source union, including zero-event, gap and cutoff dates. No future-completeness thinning.
structural_stage.stop: Any necessary gate failure closes all three roles without economics or adjacent scale/window/state/symbol/direction/exit/risk rescue. Source or engineering faults require correction.

development_gates.selection: Complete passers only; highest no-positive-financing-credit stressed net, then lower DD, then higher minimum yearly same stress, then role order. At most one unchanged survivor. No favorable fragment from a failure is retained.

confirmation.authority: Candidate-specific prospective procedural lock, not an epistemically unseen market claim. Known old project/V7/V8 aggregates and historical price exposure are disclosed; old Challenge candidate confirmation values are not inputs. Record independently defensible exposure authority before any 2026 price without changing this contract. No extra survivor, refit or tuning.
confirmation.requirements: Each epoch and pooled locked actual/all stress positive, DD <=37.39%, and >=3 first fills per all-source date. July-August latest excluded from selection; July overlaps benchmark confirmation and is disclosed, never another independent holdout. Latest unchanged actual/all stress positive and >=3 starts/date. Failure closes before native.

native_gates.evidence: Only the sole unchanged full proxy passer receives a one-time CXR2 safety/execution shell, isolated Lab runtime and required adjacent exact-benchmark comparisons on 100% real ticks with identical exercised source/spec fingerprints. No native parameter search; engineering faults corrected.

closure: Close the three-role bundle together. Preserve valid adverse results without adjacent threshold/lookback/state/symbol/direction/exit/risk or retained-fragment repair. Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 before any successor. Program 6 outside Goal. Proxy evidence never grants victory or Live authority.
